EIA ELEC bulk file, no key, fetched 2026-09-23; ELEC.PRICE against ELEC.GEN and ELEC.SALES, state-quarters, US census regions and divisions. BOTH axes cover 2018 to 2025; the
swing ranks states the same way on 2011-2017 (rho +0.62). CAVEAT: this is REGULATED RETAIL price, and 2022 was a gas shock -- the ranking on the swing axis is durable, its
level is not. Hawaii and Alaska are excluded.
